scenes.title: HKUST GCF Robotic Model Test Bay
scenes.institution: Geotechnical Centrifuge Facility robotic model test station
scenes.reference_notes: Reviewed official central-facility pages and the labelled actual-photo collage. It contains installed beam and drum centrifuges, a robotic manipulator over a stiffened model container, a shake table and an environmental enclosure. The robot/model-container panel is a local reconstruction anchor; the collage does not document a common room layout. A multi-panel collage of separate apparatus views, not a panorama. Installed supports and local model-container geometry are visible; exact spatial relationships and dimensions are unknown.
observed_cues: A perforated silver bridge with contrasting pink end plates spans the model-container opening.
Parallel edge guides and exposed round drive elements sit above the container lip.
The deep metal container uses a repeated diamond-pattern stiffening structure on its outer walls.

equipment.role: Position a four-axis inspection tool over a visible rigid model pier in a stiffened soil-model container; the scene does not spin or simulate soil response.
equipment.evidence: Original geometry informed by reviewed official photographs; hidden mechanics and scale estimated

support.evidence: Continuous authored support from machine frame to laboratory floor; independently inspect geometry
